issue: Header spans two rows (line-item label row + FY date row); six metadata rows above the table
evidence: Row 6 holds 'FY 2016'...'FY 2023'; row 7 holds the matching '12/31/20xx' dates for the same columns
fix: Read with header=None, skiprows=6, then drop the date row and assign headers manually

issue: Numbers stored as text: thousands separators, padding spaces, parenthesis negatives, % signs
fix: to_numeric() strips commas/spaces/%, converts (x) to -x, and divides percents by 100

issue: Placeholders used for missing/not-applicable data: 'NM', '#N/A N/A', em-dash '—'
sheet_row: Revenue Growth Y/Y FY2016; Net Income from Disc. Ops multiple years; Goodwill/Impairment most years; DPS FY2020
evidence: 'NM' = first-year growth has no prior-year base; '#N/A N/A' = field not populated for that period; '—' = nil or not reported that year
fix: Map all three to NaN (not zero) so they don't silently distort sums/averages; deleting the rows entirely would lose real information (e.g. that Disc. Ops was genuinely nil in some years vs not tracked in others)

issue: Subtotal rows interleaved with line items (e.g. 'Total Net Revenue', 'GROSS PROFIT', 'OPERATING PROFIT (EBIT)')
evidence: e.g. summing every row in the sheet double-counts Total Net Revenue on top of Wholesale+Retail+Other
fix: Tag is_subtotal=True on these 8 labels before any aggregation; exclude them from bottom-up sums

issue: 'Other Businesses' FY2018 extracted in EUR thousands, not EUR millions like every other cell
sheet_row: ADS GY Equity, 'Other Businesses' row, FY2018 column
evidence: Raw value '986,000' vs REV BY SEGMENT sheet's Other Businesses FY2018 = '986.0'; footnote (2) flags 'confirm the reporting unit'
fix: Corrected to 986.0 EUR mn to match the segment sheet and preserve the revenue-sum reconciliation

issue: 'Total Net Revenue' row duplicated (appears above and below the growth-rate line)
sheet_row: ADS GY Equity, two identical rows
evidence: Identical label + identical values across all 8 fiscal years
fix: Detected via duplicated(subset=[label, year, value]); dropped the second occurrence, keeping one canonical Total Net Revenue row

issue: Footnote markers embedded inside the data region (column B: '(1)','(2)','(3)')
sheet_row: Other Businesses, Financial Expenses, Reebok, Net Income from Disc. Ops rows
evidence: Numeric-looking footnote markers sit in their own column but could be mis-read as a data column
fix: Dropped the 'footnote' column from the analytical dataset; footnote text captured separately for context (IFRS16 from FY2019, Reebok discontinued-ops restatement FY2020-21, unit-check flag)

issue: Regional segmentation redefined starting FY2020; pre/post regions not directly comparable
evidence: 8 regions reported FY2016-19 vs 6 clusters FY2020-23 with different names
fix: Not fixed in Python; mapped via TABLE 2 on LOOKUP TABLES sheet in Excel to build one comparable 'Reporting Cluster' view (Stage 3.5)
